"""Build the 12 size configurations at the current commit, record sizes, hashes and feature checks."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, hashlib, datetime, time, platform

r = Path.cwd()
out = r / '.work/measure-20261117'
ALL = ['float', 'files', 'help', 'tools', 'image', 'graphics', 'audio', 'debug']
VARIANTS = {
    'full': [], 'no-float': ['float'], 'no-graphics-only': ['graphics'], 'no-audio-only': ['audio'],
    'no-graphics-no-float': ['graphics', 'float'], 'minimal': ALL,
}
GFX = ': CHECK-GRAPHICS S" REQUIRE-GRAPHICS" EVALUATE ; \' CHECK-GRAPHICS CATCH . BYE'
AUD = ': CHECK-AUDIO S" REQUIRE-AUDIO" EVALUATE ; \' CHECK-AUDIO CATCH . BYE'
FLOAT_ON = ('[DEFINED] F+ . [DEFINED] OPEN-FILE . 1.5e 2.5e F+ F>S . BYE', '-1 -1 4')
CHECKS = {
    'no-graphics-no-float': [('[DEFINED] F+ . [DEFINED] OPEN-FILE . BYE', '0 -1'), (GFX, '-270')],
    'no-graphics-only': [FLOAT_ON, (GFX, '-270'), ('REQUIRE-AUDIO 1 . BYE', '1')],
    'no-audio-only': [FLOAT_ON, (AUD, '-275'), ('REQUIRE-GRAPHICS ALSO GRAPHICS 2 3 GFX-INIT GFX-WIDTH . GFX-HEIGHT . BYE', '2 3')],
    'no-float': [
        ('REQUIRE-GRAPHICS ALSO GRAPHICS 8 8 GFX-INIT 1 1 $123456 GFX-PSET 1 1 GFX-PGET . GFX-WIDTH . GFX-HEIGHT . [DEFINED] F+ . [DEFINED] PLOT . BYE', '1193046 8 8 0 0'),
        ('REQUIRE-GRAPHICS ALSO GRAPHICS 8 8 GFX-INIT $ABCDEF COLOR! 0 0 7 7 LINE 4 4 GFX-PGET . $112233 COLOR! 1 1 2 2 FILL-RECT 2 2 GFX-PGET . 0 7 GFX-PGET . BYE', '11259375 1122867 0'),
    ],
}


def run(target, exe, source):
    cmd = [str(exe), '-e', source] if 'windows' in target else ['wsl', '--exec', '/mnt/d/home/source/zig/forthz/' + exe.relative_to(r).as_posix(), '-e', source]
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    return {'source': source, 'stdout': p.stdout, 'stderr': p.stderr, 'exit_code': p.returncode}


git = lambda *a: subprocess.run(['git', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
report = {
    'measured_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'version': (r / 'VERSION').read_text().strip(),
    'tracked_changes_outside_docs': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no', '--', '.', ':!docs'),
    'zig': subprocess.run(['zig', 'version'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(),
    'host': platform.platform(), 'optimize': 'fast', 'cpu': 'baseline', 'strip': True, 'configurations': [],
}
ok = True
for target in ('x86_64-windows-gnu', 'x86_64-linux-musl'):
    for variant, disabled in VARIANTS.items():
        label = f'{target}-{variant}'
        prefix = out / label
        cmd = ['zig', 'build', f'-Dtarget={target}', '-Doptimize=fast', '-Dcpu=baseline', '-Dstrip=true',
               *[f'-D{g}=false' for g in disabled], '--prefix', str(prefix)]
        started = time.monotonic()
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        (out / f'{label}.log').write_text(p.stdout + p.stderr, encoding='utf-8')
        if p.returncode:
            print(label, 'BUILD FAILED', p.returncode, flush=True)
            ok = False
            continue
        exe = prefix / 'bin' / ('sigma.exe' if 'windows' in target else 'sigma')
        smoke = run(target, exe, '40 2 + . BYE')
        checks = []
        for source, expected in CHECKS.get(variant, []):
            c = run(target, exe, source)
            c['expected'] = expected
            c['passed'] = c['exit_code'] == 0 and c['stdout'].strip() == expected
            checks.append(c)
        good = smoke['exit_code'] == 0 and smoke['stdout'].strip() == '42' and all(c['passed'] for c in checks)
        ok = ok and good
        entry = {'label': label, 'target': target, 'variant': variant, 'disabled': disabled, 'command': cmd,
                 'executable': exe.relative_to(r).as_posix(), 'bytes': exe.stat().st_size,
                 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'smoke_output': smoke['stdout'].strip(),
                 'smoke_exit_code': smoke['exit_code'], 'feature_checks': checks, 'build_seconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)}
        report['configurations'].append(entry)
        print(label, entry['bytes'], 'OK' if good else 'CHECK FAILED', flush=True)
        (out / 'sizes.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('ALL OK' if ok and len(report['configurations']) == 12 else 'FAILED')
sources.summarize.py:
"""Combine the size and speed measurements into the shared raw-data JSON and print the tables."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, math, subprocess, datetime

r = Path.cwd()
out = r / '.work/measure-20261117'
sizes = json.loads((out / 'sizes.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
bench = json.loads((out / 'benchmark.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
prev = json.loads((r / 'docs/measurements/2026-11-15-size-speed.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
wsl = lambda c: subprocess.run(['wsl', '--exec', 'bash', '-c', c], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()

sigma_sha = next(c['sha256'] for c in sizes['configurations'] if c['label'] == 'x86_64-linux-musl-full')
assert bench['engines'][0]['sha256'] == sigma_sha and bench['cpu_affinity'] == [0]
prev_bytes = {c['label']: c['bytes'] for c in prev['build_and_size']['configurations']}
summary, rows = {}, {}
for name, case in bench['cases'].items():
    e = case['engines']
    s, g, f = (e[k]['median_us'] for k in ('sigma', 'gforth-1.0.2', 'gforth-fast-1.0.2'))
    p = prev['benchmark']['cases'][name]['engines']
    rows[name] = {'sigma_ms': s / 1000, 'gforth_ms': g / 1000, 'gforth_fast_ms': f / 1000, 'ratio_gforth': s / g, 'ratio_fast': s / f,
                  'previous_sigma_ms': p['sigma']['median_us'] / 1000, 'sigma_change_percent': 100 * (s / p['sigma']['median_us'] - 1),
                  'gforth_change_percent': 100 * (g / p['gforth-1.0.2']['median_us'] - 1),
                  'gforth_fast_change_percent': 100 * (f / p['gforth-fast-1.0.2']['median_us'] - 1)}
for key, col in (('gforth-1.0.2', 'ratio_gforth'), ('gforth-fast-1.0.2', 'ratio_fast')):
    v = [x[col] for x in rows.values()]
    summary[key] = {'min_ratio': min(v), 'max_ratio': max(v), 'geometric_mean_ratio': math.exp(sum(map(math.log, v)) / len(v)),
                    'previous_geometric_mean_ratio': prev['summary'][key]['geometric_mean_ratio']}
summary['sigma_time_geometric_mean_change_percent'] = 100 * (math.exp(sum(math.log(1 + x['sigma_change_percent'] / 100) for x in rows.values()) / len(rows)) - 1)

report = {
    'measured_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'source_commit': sizes['commit'], 'version': sizes['version'], 'application_sources_changed': False,
    'tracked_changes_outside_docs': sizes['tracked_changes_outside_docs'],
    'previous_measurement': 'docs/measurements/2026-11-15-size-speed.json (commit ' + prev['source_commit'] + ')',
    'script_sha256': {n: sha(r / n) for n in ('scripts/benchmark-runtime.py', 'tests/scripts/test-benchmark-runtime.py')},
    'harness_test': 'python3 tests/scripts/test-benchmark-runtime.py: 3 tests OK before timing',
    'build_and_size': sizes,
    'size_change_bytes': {c['label']: c['bytes'] - prev_bytes[c['label']] for c in sizes['configurations']},
    'environment': {'platform': bench['platform'], 'python': wsl('python3 --version'), 'cpu': wsl("grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d: -f2").strip(),
                    'engines': [{'path': p, 'bytes': int(wsl(f'stat -c %s {p}')), 'sha256': wsl(f'sha256sum {p}').split()[0], 'version': wsl(f'{p} --version 2>&1')}
                                for p in ('/usr/local/bin/gforth-1.0.2-amd64', '/usr/local/bin/gforth-fast-1.0.2-amd64')]},
    'benchmark': bench, 'rows': rows, 'summary': summary,
    'sources': {n: (out / n).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for n in ('build-sizes.py', 'summarize.py')},
}
(r / 'docs/measurements/2026-11-17-size-speed.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

full = {c['target']: c['bytes'] for c in sizes['configurations'] if c['variant'] == 'full'}
for c in sizes['configurations']:
    print(f"{c['label']:42} {c['bytes']:>9,} {c['bytes'] / 1048576:.3f} {100 * (1 - c['bytes'] / full[c['target']]):5.1f}% prev={prev_bytes[c['label']]:,} diff={c['bytes'] - prev_bytes[c['label']]:+,}")
for n, x in rows.items():
    print(f"{n:10} {x['sigma_ms']:9.3f} {x['gforth_ms']:8.3f} {x['gforth_fast_ms']:8.3f} {x['ratio_gforth']:.2f} {x['ratio_fast']:.2f} | prev {x['previous_sigma_ms']:9.3f} {x['sigma_change_percent']:+.1f}% | gf {x['gforth_change_percent']:+.2f}% fast {x['gforth_fast_change_percent']:+.2f}%")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=1))
print(report['environment'])
e = bench['cases']
print('sigma spread max %:', max(100 * (c['engines']['sigma']['max_us'] / c['engines']['sigma']['min_us'] - 1) for c in e.values()))
